title: Parameters of the pellets of the Pegasus process
markdown:
| Pellet material | Polyethylene glycol (PEG) |
| --- | --- |
| Pellet size | 3×3×3 mm |
| PEG volume fraction | 10 - 20% |
| Micro-organism fraction | 2% |
| Density | 1.03 g/cm³ |
| Surface area | 700 m²/m³ reactor volume |
| Biofilm thickness | ~ 60 μm |
notes: Printed below the table: 'Source: Hitachi Plant Technologies, Ltd., 2010'.
The table prints no column headings: the first printed row is a label/value pair ('Pellet material' / 'Polyethylene glycol (PEG)') and is kept as the header row.
Printed '3×3×3 mm' uses a multiplication sign; retained (Table 5.58 on page 504 prints a lower-case x).
Printed '~ 60 μm' with a space after the tilde; retained.
Printed as 'Micro-organism fraction' with a hyphen; retained.
Printed '700 m2/m3 reactor volume' superscripts both exponents; written m²/m³.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: All six label rows and values read from a 300 dpi crop; the multiplication signs, the micro sign and the tilde spacing checked at 400 dpi.
